properties.name: Sun Walk service area (provisional)
properties.extent: Core campus bounded by University Dr (N), Rural Rd (E), Apache Blvd (S), Mill Ave (W), plus a southern corridor to Vista del Sol and a northern corridor to Sun Devil Stadium.
